---
title = "Project Structure"
---

# Simple rendering

For a document with default settings, just render it:

```
calepin render paper.qmd
```

No configuration, no scaffolding. *Calepin* uses built-in templates and writes the output alongside the input file.

# Customizing a document

To customize templates or configuration, create a sidecar:

```
calepin init paper.qmd
```

This creates `paper.qmd` (if it does not exist) and a `paper_calepin/` directory next to it, containing a `config.toml` and all built-in templates for the target. Edit the templates to change how your document looks, then render as usual:

```
calepin render paper.qmd
```

To target a specific format:

```
calepin init paper.qmd -t latex
```

The sidecar directory structure:

```
paper.qmd
paper_calepin/
  config.toml            # per-document configuration
  templates/html/        # template overrides (target-specific)
    main.html
    figure.html
    ...
  assets/                # static assets (CSS, JS, images)
.calepin/                # code execution cache (gitignored)
  cache/paper/           # code chunk cache
```

When a sidecar exists, *Calepin* uses only the sidecar templates. When there is no sidecar, it uses only the built-in templates. There is no mixing or layering between the two.

# Websites

To scaffold a website:

```
calepin init my_site -t website
```

This creates a directory with an `index_calepin/config.toml` manifest, an `index.qmd`, and example pages:

```
my_site/
  index_calepin/
    config.toml          # project configuration
    templates/website/   # template overrides
    assets/              # CSS, JS, images, logos
  index.qmd
  about.qmd
  guide/
    intro.qmd
    advanced.qmd
  .calepin/              # code execution cache (gitignored)
    cache/               # code execution cache
  index_output/           # rendered site (gitignored)
```

Preview immediately:

```
calepin preview my_site
```

# Key directories

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `index_calepin/config.toml` | Project configuration (targets, sidebar, navbar, etc.) |
| `index_calepin/templates/` | Template overrides. All templates for the active target. |
| `index_calepin/assets/` | Static assets (CSS, images, logos) copied to output. |
| `index_output/` | Default output directory for websites (configurable in `config.toml`). |
| `.calepin/cache/` | Execution cache (per-document). |

# Managing templates

To compare your templates against the built-in defaults:

```
calepin templates diff index.qmd
```

To see the status of all templates:

```
calepin templates list index.qmd
```

To revert a specific template to the built-in version:

```
calepin templates reset index.qmd base.html
```

To revert all templates:

```
calepin templates reset index.qmd --force
```
